rule: ADR 0008 — a default visual change needs incumbent/variant evidence and a logged human decision. This file indexes pending work; it never records a verdict.

experiments.hypothesis: Viewport-derived chapter columns pack a wide canvas better than the fixed two-column default.
Grouped controls in a toggled overlay beat a permanent command bar for the five UI tasks.
experiments.variant: ?ui=menus — controls mounted under their original ids in an overlay
experiments.command: pnpm --filter pi exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/ui-compare.spec.ts --grep menus

experiments.hypothesis: Four labelled status sections read better than one attention line.
experiments.variant: ?ui=statusline — attention, event, counters and view sections
experiments.command: pnpm --filter pi exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/ui-compare.spec.ts --grep statusline

experiments.hypothesis: Drawing one hierarchy at 1x, 1/2x and 1/4x in one frame makes self-similar structure visible at fit zoom.
experiments.variant: ?shot=octaves — opt-in multi-octave layout, plus ?shot=octaves-near zoom evidence

experiments.hypothesis: Tight ring geometry with step colouring per octave reads more clearly than the incumbent ring or a golden-angle spiral.
experiments.command: cd app/demo && pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/scale-lab.spec.ts --workers=1
experiments.note: Ring geometry stays clean; spiral candidates (spiral-070-d3, spiral-050-d3) overlap at these radii. Step colouring made the octave hierarchy legible without a renderer change. No Pi default flip; porting the palette back needs a separate opt-in host-side colour seam and a human verdict.
